title: Staged schema commitment and fidelity grades for streamed toolcalls
author: Ava Munroe
description: Motivation: production LLMs perform tool/function calls where structured output must be validated; strict immediate schema enforcement during token streaming causes frequent early rejects (esp. for multi-step toolcall handoffs) and harms latency. This PR introduces a staged commitment model for JSON-schema style response_format where enforcement has graded fidelity levels and a distinct commit phase for toolcall-delimited streams. Goals: (1) allow the model to produce partially-formed structured output during streaming without triggering hard rejection; (2) provide a post-toolcall validation step that can accept/coerce or surface actionable errors with fine-grained error taxonomies; (3) keep OpenAI-compat layer semantics consistent (response_format remains the canonical hint) while adding backward-compatible flags for strictness grading.
summary: Implements staged schema commitment with three fidelity grades (permissive, graded-verify, strict-commit), streaming checkpoints that mark schema anchor points, and a post-toolcall commit/verification phase. Adds OpenAI-compat mapping for new response_format hints and SDK helpers for negotiating fidelity levels.

review_comments: Diego Ramos (review): Nice design. Two concerns: how do we avoid state explosion if a single request emits multiple nested toolcalls? Please clarify lifecycle and GC semantics.

Author (Ava): The runtime tracks a single staged-commit timeline per top-level request. Nested toolcalls create sub-anchors that roll up into the parent commit; GC is time-and-count based (default 30s / 3 anchors) and is configurable via route config.
Priya Shah (review): Metric names look good but add cardinality limits; also please ensure we don't log full payloads in telemetry (PII risk).
Author (Ava): Updated metrics to use hashed IDs and counters only. Removed payload sampling in the telemetry call sites and added redact hooks. See final commit f0b9d20.
Kenji Ito (approval): Verified tests and canary run. One optional nit: consider a small README in runtime/streaming explaining anchor token format for future contributors.
release_notes: Introduce staged schema commitment: new fidelity grades (permissive, graded-verify, strict-commit) and streaming anchor checkpoints. Backward compatible: default behavior remains permissive unless route or request opts into graded/strict. Adds SDK helpers and docs. See docs/api/structured_output/staged_commit.md for migration guidance.
testing_summary: Unit coverage added for state machine transitions and fidelity grader. Integration tests simulate nested toolcalls with delayed commits. E2E canary deployed to perf-canary for 48h with no regression in tail latency. Observability dashboard added for staged_commit.success, staged_commit.rollback, staged_commit.latency.
notes_for_ops: Canary toggle available via feature flag 'staged_schema_commit'. Default config keeps permissive mode; customers can enable graded or strict per-route. Ops must ensure rollout of SDK clients that surface fidelity hints if strict-commit is used.
